kids_evidence: store/apps/HerJourney.json:28 primary_category HEALTH_AND_FITNESS; docs/store-policy/HerJourney.md:42 '1.3 Kids Category: no'. Audience: adult cycle, pregnancy and menopause tracking (spec HerJourney.md:41). No store/ratings/HerJourney.json, so default.json applies.

banner.where: lib/screens/history/log_history_screen.dart:240 (one AglAdBanner after the last History entry)

interstitial.why: RootScaffold defaults onAdTransition to AglAds.onTransition (lib/screens/root_scaffold.dart:16) and fires it when moving between Calendar and Record (:43-47). This is reproductive-health tracking, a sensitive context where a full-screen ad feels intrusive. Founder question F2 ('should a reproductive-health app show ads at all?') is open (spec HerJourney.md:302).

native.why: The only list is the History log (log_history_screen.dart:227-260 ListView.builder over HealthLog entries). It holds the user's own health data (periods, symptoms, mood), a sensitive data screen where the founder rule forbids native. The app has no browse or discovery content list.

rewarded.why: Nothing to reward: everything is free, with no quota, premium tier or IAP (grep in lib/ finds none). The founder leans no for health/cycle tracking.

blockers: Founder decision F2 (ads in a reproductive-health app) is open: spec HerJourney.md:302
